transforms.name: normalized-activity
transforms.effect: copilot turn, tool, or child activity is stored as a status-family activity claim.

transforms.name: reduce-activity
transforms.effect: The reducer upserts or retracts the activity claim. Completion clears it.

transforms.name: derive-activity
transforms.effect: agentActivity copies kind, a bounded line, and since when the timestamp parses. No activity object means the row omits it.

defaults.when: runtime state is absent and the host run is not pending

transport.name: AgentMonitorService.consume
transport.contract: turn, tool, or monitor activity to deriveAgentRow
